page_title: ATM 0-1 CEL | Atletico Madrid v Celta Vigo 09/05/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+4' The referee blows for the end of today's match.
90+2' Ionut Radu pulls off a great save to block a header from Marc Pubill (Atl. Madrid) after a nice lofted cross.
90+1' The referee signals a substitution. Mihailo Ristic (Celta Vigo) is brought on as a substitute for Oscar Mingueza.
90' 3 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
88' Thiago Almada (Atl. Madrid) swings in a dangerous cross from the resulting corner kick, but none of his teammates manage to outjump the defence.
88' Ionut Radu makes a difficult save to deny Miguel Cubo (Atl. Madrid), who attempted to score with a header from inside the box. Atl. Madrid will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
87' Koke (Atl. Madrid) shoots inside the box, but is denied by a timely block.
86' Thiago Almada (Atl. Madrid) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates. The ball is easily cleared out of danger.
86' Koke (Atl. Madrid) delivers a crossfield pass, but the ball is cut out before it reaches its intended target. Atl. Madrid force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
85' Koke (Atl. Madrid) puts a cross into the box from the corner but there is no panic from the opposition and they easily clear.
85' Marcos Llorente (Atl. Madrid) crosses the ball forward but it is intercepted. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Atl. Madrid.
80' High and wide! Matteo Ruggeri (Atl. Madrid) hits a first-time shot from distance that's none too pretty and goes miles wide of the left post.
77' A substitution has been made. Williot Swedberg is replaced by Hugo Alvarez (Celta Vigo).
77' A yellow card for a tackle by Fernando Lopez (Celta Vigo). Iosu Galech doesn't hesitate at all to make this decision.
76' Koke (Atl. Madrid) takes the corner which is cleared by the opposition's defence.
75' Marcos Llorente (Atl. Madrid) attempts to send a pass but the effort is blocked. The referee blows his whistle, Atl. Madrid are awarded a corner kick.
75' Miguel Cubo (Atl. Madrid) latches onto a decent pass, but flashes his shot just wide of the right post.
72' Alexander Sorloth (Atl. Madrid) is first to react to a lofted pass from Koke, but fires his header miles over the bar from near the penalty spot.
71' Marcos Llorente (Atl. Madrid) connects with the resulting free kick on the edge of the box, but can't find the target as his effort goes high over the bar.
69' That's the end of the game for Alex Baena, who is replaced by Obed Vargas (Atl. Madrid).
69' Substitution. Robin Le Normand leaves the pitch and is replaced by Miguel Cubo (Atl. Madrid).
68' Substitution. Sergio Carreira (Celta Vigo) in, Alvaro Nunez out.
68' Claudio Giraldez decides to make a substitution. Pablo Duran will be replaced by Iago Aspas (Celta Vigo).
68' Substitution. Ferran Jutgla (Celta Vigo) on for Borja Iglesias.
66' Alex Baena (Atl. Madrid) sees a yellow card. He should be more careful because one more challenge like that could result in a red card.
65' A long cross from the side is directed to the well-positioned Alexander Sorloth (Atl. Madrid), but the defence gets it clear.
62' 0 - 1 Goal! Borja Iglesias (Celta Vigo) gets to the ball inside the box, sees the goalkeeper off his line and lifts the ball over him and into the back of the net. 0:1.
61' Here comes a substitution. Antoine Griezmann is given a rest as he is replaced by Thiago Almada (Atl. Madrid).
60' Diego Simeone has decided to substitute Ademola Lookman and he is replaced by Nahuel Molina (Atl. Madrid).
57' Ademola Lookman (Atl. Madrid) misses an absolute sitter after connecting with a cross inside the penalty box.
55' Antoine Griezmann (Atl. Madrid) fails to beat the offside trap and the linesman puts his flag up.
53' The ball is whipped in from the corner by Antoine Griezmann (Atl. Madrid), but one of the defenders gets it clear.

52' Alexander Sorloth (Atl. Madrid) came close to scoring but should have done much better. His poor attempt from close range ended up in the gloves of Ionut Radu. Atl. Madrid force their opponents to concede a corner.
51' Ilaix Moriba (Celta Vigo) has an effort from the edge of the area, but he skies the ball over the top.
48' David Hancko (Atl. Madrid) is inside the box in a promising position to head home! His poor header flies into the stands. What a poor effort that was!
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+3' The end of the first half.
45+1' Koke (Atl. Madrid) works the corner short instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
45' 2 additional min. will be played.
41' Pablo Duran (Celta Vigo) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
39' Looks like Pablo Duran (Celta Vigo) is struggling after picking up a knock. Hopefully he can run it off.
39' Iosu Galech blows his whistle and it's Alexander Sorloth (Atl. Madrid) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
38' Antoine Griezmann (Atl. Madrid) hits a dipping shot from the edge of the box that's well off target and flies miles wide of the left post.
37' Antoine Griezmann (Atl. Madrid) will take a free kick. Is he going to strike the ball directly at the goal? Let's find out!
34' A dangerous looking corner kick from Antoine Griezmann (Atl. Madrid) is cleared to safety by the defence.
34' Marcos Llorente (Atl. Madrid) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being blocked by one of the defenders. Atl. Madrid have a corner.
33' The flag is raised and Borja Iglesias (Celta Vigo) is offside again, not for the first time today.
33' Borja Iglesias (Celta Vigo) goes for goal, but his effort isn't precise at all and it flies yards wide of the right post.
32' Fernando Lopez (Celta Vigo) plays a through ball inside the box, but it's too strong and Jan Oblak comes off his line to intercept.
30' Borja Iglesias (Celta Vigo) is in a clear offside position and the referee blows his whistle after the linesman raises his flag.

29' Nice touch by Alexander Sorloth (Atl. Madrid) as he latched on to an accurate cross and attempted to direct the ball with a fine header towards the net, but the goalkeeper reacted quickly to keep it out.
27' Antoine Griezmann (Atl. Madrid) aims a low effort to the middle of the goal, but the goalkeeper makes a comfortable save.
26' Alex Baena (Atl. Madrid) takes the corner, but one of the defenders reacts well and rises highest to head the ball away.
26' Ademola Lookman (Atl. Madrid) shoots from outside the box, but his effort is blocked. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Atl. Madrid.
23' Oscar Mingueza (Celta Vigo) attempts to find one of his teammates, but puts far too much on the pass and the chance is gone.
22' Marcos Alonso (Celta Vigo) sends a long ball forward to Borja Iglesias, but he put too much power and the chance is gone.
21' The free kick from long range, taken by Atl. Madrid, is overhit and the ball goes out of play.
20' Diego Simeone is forced to make a change. Jose Maria Gimenez is not able to carry on due to injury. He is replaced by Robin Le Normand (Atl. Madrid).
19' Iosu Galech shows a yellow card to Ilaix Moriba (Celta Vigo) for a tough tackle.
17' Antoine Griezmann (Atl. Madrid) decides to speed play up with a short corner kick.
16' Marcos Llorente (Atl. Madrid) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. Atl. Madrid have been awarded a corner kick.
15' Pablo Duran (Celta Vigo) finds himself beyond the last defender, but the game is stopped by the referee after the linesman signals for offside.
12' Ademola Lookman (Atl. Madrid) receives a lofted pass from the side and shoots from around the penalty spot, but the ball flies onto the left post!
11' Ademola Lookman (Atl. Madrid) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
7' The attendance for today's match is 52643.
7' Flag up against Marcos Llorente (Atl. Madrid). He had space to move into behind the defence, but he went too soon.
7' Marcos Llorente (Atl. Madrid) tries to send the ball in front of the goal, but the opposition's defence averts the threat.
6' Alex Baena (Atl. Madrid) fires a shot at goal from a very promising position outside the penalty area, but it is blocked by a self-sacrificing defender.
4' Koke (Atl. Madrid) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player.
3' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Atl. Madrid.
2' Antoine Griezmann (Atl. Madrid) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away. Atl. Madrid will take a corner kick.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
